critical_queries.name: Load accepted snapshot membership
critical_queries.sql: SELECT ... FROM profiling.profile_snapshot_members m JOIN profiling.bam_profiles p ON p.id = m.bam_profile_id WHERE m.snapshot_id = $1 AND m.partition = 'train' ORDER BY m.member_index

critical_queries.name: Load a feature matrix
critical_queries.sql: SELECT ... FROM profiling.feature_matrix_members WHERE matrix_id = $1 ORDER BY row_index

critical_queries.name: Persist or replay an experiment plan
critical_queries.sql: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING into plans/members/configs, then re-read by plan_hash under a plan-scoped advisory lock

critical_queries.locking: row locks on inserted keys only
critical_queries.name: Enqueue a bounded job slice
critical_queries.sql: INSERT INTO experiments.experiment_jobs ... ON CONFLICT (job_key) DO NOTHING for a bounded slice

critical_queries.locking: single row, SKIP LOCKED, never a table lock
critical_queries.name: Claim next pending job
critical_queries.sql: SELECT id FROM experiments.experiment_jobs WHERE plan_id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1

critical_queries.name: Start or release a claim
critical_queries.sql: UPDATE experiments.experiment_jobs SET status = $2 WHERE id = $1 AND claimed_by = $3 AND status = $4

critical_queries.locking: one job row FOR UPDATE; serializes success vs failure
critical_queries.name: Record success or failure
critical_queries.sql: Lock the job row FOR UPDATE, insert the attempt outcome row, then UPDATE the job to its terminal status requiring exactly one affected row

critical_queries.name: Retrieve result and artifacts
critical_queries.sql: SELECT ... FROM experiments.execution_results r JOIN catalog.artifacts a ON a.id = r.vcf_artifact_id JOIN catalog.artifact_locations l ON l.artifact_id = a.id AND l.is_primary WHERE r.job_id = $1

critical_queries.name: Verify a plan graph
critical_queries.sql: Read plan, members, configs and jobs for one plan_id in a single read-only transaction that is rolled back

critical_queries.name: List stale claims
critical_queries.sql: SELECT id FROM experiments.experiment_jobs WHERE status IN ('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND lease_expires_at < now()

critical_queries.name: Reconcile missing or corrupt artifacts
critical_queries.sql: SELECT a.id, l.object_key FROM catalog.artifacts a JOIN catalog.artifact_locations l ON l.artifact_id = a.id WHERE a.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND (a.last_verified_at IS NULL OR a.last_verified_at < $1) ORDER BY a.last_verified_at

critical_queries.name: Evaluate scores
critical_queries.sql: SELECT s.score FROM evaluation.evaluation_scores s WHERE s.scoring_version = $1 ORDER BY s.score DESC LIMIT $2

critical_queries.name: Activate a model or config
critical_queries.sql: UPDATE models.model_activations SET deactivated_at = now() WHERE deactivated_at IS NULL; INSERT the new activation row

critical_queries.name: Produce an operational health report
critical_queries.sql: Aggregate job status counts, open attempts, unverified artifacts, latest backup set and service heartbeats

inline_payload_policy.hashing: content_sha256 is always computed over the exact stored bytes, whether inline or external, so an artifact's identity is independent of storage mode.
inline_payload_policy.rule: A payload may be stored inline only when it is canonical JSON, <= 65536 bytes, and required on a latency-critical read path. Inline payloads are stored as bytea holding the EXACT canonical bytes, never as JSONB, so the content SHA-256 stays byte-deterministic. JSONB is used only for bounded descriptive documents (provenance, feature definitions) that are never hashed.

partitioning_policy.identifier_strategy: UUIDv7 for the three append-only high-volume tables above, so index locality follows insertion time without exposing a bigint externally. All other tables use random UUIDv4.
partitioning_policy.rule: No table is partitioned at design time. Partitioning is enabled per table only when a measured threshold is crossed.

thresholds.enable_when: row count > 50,000,000 OR table size > 50 GB

performance_targets.metric: Q7 claim next pending job, 8 concurrent workers
Q9 result persistence excluding GATK runtime
lock wait on the claim path
restore duration to a qualification database

performance_targets.target: 0 bytes of payload; metadata only, <= 2 KB per artifact row

principles: One authoritative operational database; ephemeral clusters for tests only.
Large immutable payloads live outside PostgreSQL, fully managed by artifact records.
UUID primary keys for every externally referenced entity; foreign keys for relationships.
Exactly one aggregate scientific hash per frozen entity; one content SHA-256 per artifact.
Current job state is a narrow mutable row; history is append-only and never replayed to derive current state.
No runtime path issues SET ROLE; the object owner is unreachable by runtime credentials.
Constraints first, narrow functions second, triggers only where neither can enforce the invariant safely.

projected_scale.note: No partitioning is created for the projected scale; the thresholds in partitioning_policy govern when it is enabled.
